name: grimoire-vtt
description: GrimoireVTT — Dark Fantasy D&D 5e Virtual Tabletop

scripts.dev: pnpm dev:kill-ports && pnpm --filter @grimoire/shared build && node scripts/dev-supervisor.mjs
scripts.dev:raw: pnpm --filter @grimoire/shared build && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @grimoire/server dev" "pnpm --filter @grimoire/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @grimoire/shared build && pnpm --filter @grimoire/monster-dex build && node scripts/stage-compendium-data.mjs && pnpm --filter @grimoire/server db:generate && pnpm --filter @grimoire/server build && pnpm --filter @grimoire/client build && node scripts/stage-client-dist.mjs
